answer: The strongest single control I know for this is AI-generated content detector score proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 729 keys multiplies the price 729-fold: 73629 POA locked, or 10935 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The beacon of the design is public, the saffron of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ridge of honest work is what finally pays. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
